status: Locally frozen before fresh-cohort selection and waveform evaluation; motivated by earlier exploratory findings, not externally registered

cohort.exclude: all patients in original 5500-person manifest, plus previously inspected pilot ECGs 1,101,1013
cohort.selection: uniform without replacement, label independent; no outcome or confidence filtering

models.training: frozen existing states; original training-only preprocessing RMS and centering/projection

shift_control.offsets: five without-replacement offsets from 1..19 windows, circular, identical across leads; same offset draws across tasks, methods and model seeds
shift_control.dose: each shifted raw intervention rescaled to the guided intervention's L2 norm; projected operator also restored to that norm
shift_control.averaging: average shift responses within patient before averaging seeds or bootstrap; shifts are not independent patients
shift_control.geometry: report paired shifted-minus-guided normal-energy fraction and 95% CI; within +/-0.05 mean-fraction interval is an operational balance diagnostic, not a clinical equivalence claim; also report patient absolute mismatch

statistics.primary_family: 12 time_shift_dose_matched advantage-change endpoints, 2 architectures x 2 tasks x 3 methods
statistics.primary_interval: Bonferroni 99.583333% paired patient percentile intervals; models/seeds and sampled shifts held fixed
statistics.secondary_intervals: descriptive 95%, including geometry balance and paired shift-minus-amplitude change
statistics.relative_change: ratio of mean advantage change to mean independent advantage, jointly resampled numerator/denominator; mark unstable if denominator CI includes zero
statistics.interpretation: No binary causal attribution or clinical equivalence claim; persistence or attenuation interpreted alongside measured geometry and dose

wrapper_confirmation.template: unchanged random normal template from positive_control_test.npz
wrapper_confirmation.success: recomputed independent saliency-minus-IG gap negative at lambda0, positive at lambda10, and energy-matched gap negative at lambda10, each with Bonferroni 98.333333% CI across these three gaps
wrapper_confirmation.invariance: consistent-input logits, fixed-mask consistent responses, signed tangent gradients
wrapper_confirmation.scope: confirmation of a previously posthoc selected constructed example; does not turn failed historical controls into successes or establish natural-model frequency
